verdict.rationale: Tavily documents API keys, multiple keys per account or organization, Development/Production environments tied to a key (which only change rate limits), Project IDs for usage attribution, and OAuth so keys need not be hardcoded. None of these is a documented way to issue a credential limited to certain endpoints, permissions, or spend for an agent. These are adjacent controls covering attribution, rate tiers and authentication method, not least-privilege scoping.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
